outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph, not a plot showing averages.
Panel B is a micrograph (H&E histology), not a plot showing averages.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt, already shows distribution) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp numbers per genotype/diameter category with n=8-18 mice per genotype; the bar chart does not overlay individual per-mouse data points, only aggregated bar heights.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels relative to total, shown with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Panel F is an immunohistochemistry micrograph, not a plot showing averages.
Panel G includes a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars but without individual data points shown.
